strongest_angle: Anthropic has introduced Claude Motion and Claude Dashboards in beta, allowing professionals to generate animated workflow explainers and live-updating data dashboards straight from text prompts.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic launched Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion in beta on October 8, 2026, enabling users to create animated workflow explainers and live data dashboards.
The Verge reported on October 8, 2026, that Claude Motion can create a 30-second video explainer that users can download as an MP4 file.
According to the Claude Help Center, Claude Motion is available in beta on Team and Enterprise plans starting October 8, 2026.
Anthropic announced that Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are new artifact types designed for creating interactive workflows and charts.
